newsitem.title: USA: Immulogic stock falls after product trial delay.
newsitem.headline: Immulogic stock falls after product trial delay.

text.p: The stock of ImmuLogic Pharmaceutical Corp. fell sharply Friday, a day after the biopharmaceutical company said it had suspended clinical trials of a drug for ragweed allergies.
The stock slid 62.5 cents, or more than 16 percent to $3.125 on Nasdaq shortly before midday.

The Waltham, Mass.-based company said it had to provide more information to the Food and Drug Administration before it could go ahead with the trial of its Allervax Ragweed product, which was originally scheduled for July.

"Because the trial must be conducted in the summer ragweed season, the additional time required to respond to the FDA request will delay the potential initiation of the study until the summer of 1998," it said.
ImmuLogic develops products to treat allergies and diseases of the immune system.
